SELECT GROUP_CNAME,GROUP_ENAME, TASK_GROUP_CNAME, TASK_GROUP_ENAME, TASK_GROUP_ORDERNO, TMP_CNAME,TMP_ENAME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME FROM INTERF_TEMPLATE_GROUP itg where 1=1 and flag = #{flag}
AND itg.TMP_CNAME like concat_ws('', '%',#{TmpCName},'%')

SELECT TMP_ENAME AS id, TMP_CNAME AS text FROM INTERF_TEMPLATE_GROUP itg where 1=1
AND itg.TmpCName like concat_ws('','%',#{TmpCName},'%')

SELECT ac.seqno ,AC.BUSI_DATE busiDate,AC.END_TIME, CASE IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0) WHEN 0 THEN '02' ELSE '09'END STATUS, CASE WHEN LOG.TMP_NAME in ('ftp-download','sftp-download') THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0)!=0 AND IFNULL(LOG.SUCCESS,0)=0 THEN '文件不存在' WHEN IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0) =0 AND IFNULL(LOG.SUCCESS,0)!=0 THEN '下载成功' END ELSE CASE IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0) WHEN 0 THEN concat_ws('','执行成功',IFNULL(LOG.success,''),'条') ELSE concat_ws('','执行成功',IFNULL(LOG.success,0),'条,失败',IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0),'条') END END detailAction ,IFNULL(GR.TASK_GRP_NAME,LOG.FILE_NAME) taskCname, log.TMP_NAME EName,ac.START_TIME startTime FROM ( SELECT TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO, CASE IS_CHECK WHEN 'Y' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END SUCCESS, CASE IS_CHECK WHEN 'N' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END ERROR FROM VAL_INTERFLOG GROUP BY TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO,IS_CHECK )LOG left join ( SELECT TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME FROM bok_BATCH_TASK_GRP GROUP BY TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME ) GR on GR.TASK_GRP_ID = LOG.TMP_NAME LEFT JOIN VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG AC ON AC.SEQNO=LOG.PARENT_SEQNO WHERE AC.SEQNO = #{seqno}
